name: Financial Assistance to Persons Suffering from Rare Diseases
benefit: 1. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹3,000/- per month will be provided starting from 01.01.2024.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a domicile and bonafide resident of Haryana.
   1. There are no age restrictions for applicants.
   1. The applicant&#39;s annual family income should be less than ₹3,00,000/-.
   1. The applicant must possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra.
   1. The applicant should be suffering from any of the Rare Diseases i.e. the medical conditions/diseases, mentioned in the National Policy for Rare Diseases, 2021, issued by MoHFW (GoI) &amp; added from time to time; and diagnosed at any of the notified ‘Centres of Excellence’ (CoE), designated by MoHFW, GoI &amp; added from time to time; under the said policy.

**Note:** The financial assistance will be provided in addition to any benefits the applicant receives under other social security pension schemes.
